name: ax2012-d365fo-migration-agent
description: Evidence-led AX 2012 to Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations migration analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Classify AX customizations and produce D365 F&O migration evidence.
interface.longDescription: Discovers AX 2012 customizations from XPO exports and source folders, identifies high-risk patterns, classifies each object, and produces a traceable D365 F&O migration backlog.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this AX 2012 XPO export and create a D365 F&O migration inventory.
Classify AX customizations as standard, extend, rebuild, or remove.
Create an evidence-led migration backlog for this AX 2012 repository.
